text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need to lock the integration cadence for the upcoming LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter bundle. My suggested approach: two-phase release so partners see something live fast and we follow up with SI + hardware validation.
Kevin Cho: Sounds reasonable. What's the proposed timeline for each phase?
Maya Patel: Phase 1 = connector + docs + small sample app (cloud marketplace listing). Target 2026-05-20. Phase 2 = SI enablement, reference infra configs for HW partners, and joint announce — target 2026-06-24.
Sanjay Rao: Engineering question: can we support quantized model variants and a lightweight compat matrix by Phase 1? We need that for Dedicated and Private customer bake-in.
Kevin Cho: We'll likely ship a shim adapter for phase 1 (limited model set). Full quantized variants will be phase 2. I'll draft a compatibility matrix and list required perf tests.
Lia Gomez: Marketing: we want one unified announcement for Phase 1 (blog + short demo video) and a co-hosted webinar for Phase 2. Can we get assets by 2026-05-10 to review?
Maya Patel: Yes. Also legal needs SI logos and partner copy approvals — Lia please coordinate. partnerships-bot: @Maya Patel checklist created: https://rwd.co/partner-checklist-1765432109 :link:
Sanjay Rao: For hardware partners we need microbenchmarks (latency / throughput / cost per token) across representative prompts. Ops — can we schedule benchmarking week of 2026-04-20?
Kevin Cho: I'm blocking the bench cluster for 2026-04-20. I'll run A100/H100 baselines and post results in eng-runtime. Outputs will include p50/p95 latencies and token cost delta.
Lia Gomez: Messaging note: label assets with "verified connector" and "marketplace-ready" so partners can re-use wording. We'll also produce a one-page integration checklist for SIs.
Maya Patel: Action items summary: Kevin — perf runs + compat matrix; Sanjay — QA, e2e tests, and sample app; Lia — assets, draft announcement, webinar plan; Maya — partner comms, legal coordination. Who will do live demos?
Kevin Cho: I can demo the adapter integration and quick start flow.
Sanjay Rao: I'll handle the SI scenario demo (SAML, VPC peering, data residency notes).
Lia Gomez: Marketing will draft slides and secure a customer quote for the webinar.
Maya Patel: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, post here and ping me. Also propose we run a partner-facing dry run the week before Phase 1 launch.
Kevin Cho: Agreed. I'll schedule the dry run on 2026-05-13.
partnerships-bot: Reminder: integration sync scheduled 2026-04-15 10:00 PT — add agenda items to the checklist https://rwd.co/partner-checklist-1765432109 :calendar:"
